decision: Detect routing, focused-stage and reviewer delegation, human-authority, boundary, native-representation, execution, provenance, and evidence failures in gen-stack before release; this suite does not approve the skill.

scope.intended_use: Briefing humans on bounded Gen Stack state; orienting the canonical change-realization Process to focused sibling stages and fresh reviewer delegation; and assisting with authority-gated corpus adoption, migration, Requirement lifecycle, Architecture, Evaluation Protocol, native representation, and explicitly accepted meaning while preserving human ratification and peer authorities.
scope.case_source: Synthetic Gen Stack current-state briefs, Process and shaping orientation, focused Pitch routing, exact change-artifact synchronization orientation and routing, decision support, Requirement impact and change operations, identity and lifecycle, replacement lineage, non-transfer of evidence, partial acceptance, greenfield and brownfield candidate development, Surface and C4 structure extraction, Requirement inference and placement, material gap disposition, fixed repository gen-stack/ discovery, authority-gated adoption and migration, established-corpus authoring, governed Evaluation Protocol authoring, work-item authoring, native-format and exact-field mapping, fallback representation, transient Change Design, derived projections, repository-native Evaluation execution and Process artifacts, authority-precedence, provenance, metadata projection, relationship and lifecycle maintenance, persisted readback, partial batch failure, human-ratification, and routing-collision cases.
